messages.content: Hello! I'm KrishiVoice, your farming assistant. How can I help you today? You can tell me what crop you grow, ask about water, fertilizer, weather, or what to plant for profit.
I am planting rice in wet land with canal water

Good — you're planting Rice at your area, Tamil Nadu. Your wetland field For starting out: keep soil moist, about 50 mm every 5 days (Maintain 2–5 cm standing water if canal-fed wetland). Basal fertilizer: Urea 50 kg/ha top-dress + MOP 25 kg/ha if K low — N 50 kg/ha. Pin your farm on the map in profile for weather-based alerts.
How much water should I give?

For your Rice (Tillering) on Clay Loam soil at your area, Tamil Nadu: irrigate every 5 days, 50 mm (~2 times/week). Maintain 2–5 cm standing water if canal-fed wetland Each watering ≈ 500,000 litres for your farm. Your moisture is 38.0% (ideal ~30%). No urgent irrigation today.
What vegetable has high profit demand?

Best crops for your Wetland land (Monsoon season (Jun–Oct)): 1. Banana — demand 10/10, profit potential 7/10. Price hint: ₹25-45/dozen. 2. Rice — demand 9/10, profit potential 6/10. Price hint: ₹22-28/kg, avg yield 4.2 t/ha. 3. Sugarcane — demand 9/10, profit potential 6/10. Price hint: Govt FRP ~₹3400/ton, avg yield 2.2 t/ha. 4. Maize — demand 8/10, profit potential 6/10. Price hint: ₹18-24/kg. Rice demand score: 9/10, profit potential: 6/10. Best season: Kharif. Price hint: ₹22-28/kg.
